data.title: Trump Estates
data.about:
If exclusive privileges and an opulent lifestyle are your preferences, The Trump Estate villas are your perfect bet. These villas have beautiful breathtaking views overlooking the Trump International Golf Club Dubai. In addition to that, residents will have a personal golf cart to traverse the green community, as well as, an exclusive Trump Lifestyle Card. The interiors are tastefully designed with pale golds complemented by cream, bronze and black accents.

Residents of The Trump Estates will have access to the Trump International Golf Club, its beautiful fairways, and private enclaves. Not just that, residents will also have access to private swimming pools, spacious balconies, as well as all the world-class amenities offered by Damac Hills. This includes themed gardens, sporting amenities, skating park and more. Your home will be minutes away from the beach and Dubai International Airport. It will also be in proximity to Madinat Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Business Bay. Live the exclusive golfing experience at The Trump Estates.

location_tile.title: A master development with everything you’ll need
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: DAMAC Hills offers little reason for you to venture away from home. However, with a convenient location close to major road networks, you’ll find the city centre within easy reach.
